summary: The trace shows a successful timesheet policy audit using openpyxl and python-docx, following patterns similar to existing spreadsheet audit skills. The key novel capability is role-based threshold lookup from a separate rules sheet (BreakRules) to compute compliance flags (Break Deficit, Approval Missing). The agent spent significant time debugging empty cell handling (None vs empty string), confirming that openpyxl converts empty strings to None on save/load - this is standard behavior but caused verification confusion. The task succeeded and verifier passed. The existing 'spreadsheet-audit-reporting' skill already covers the core workflow; this update adds the timesheet-specific variant with role-based rules lookup pattern.
